name: Dinosaur Island Xtreme Edition

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when only one objective card is left unclaimed; finish the round, then final scoring (or after 7 rounds)

categories.label: VP on track during play
categories.hint: 1 VP per surviving patron at an attraction or exhibit each Park phase (hooligans and queued visitors score nothing); lost VPs for eaten visitors are already deducted.

categories.label: Attractions in park (VP printed)
categories.hint: One entry per attraction: the VP listed on it.

categories.label: Dinosaur exhibits (VP x dinosaurs)
categories.labelVi: Điểm các exhibit (VP x số khủng long)
categories.hint: One entry per exhibit: printed VP x dinosaurs in that paddock; enter -10 for an exhibit with no dinosaurs.

categories.label: Claimed objectives (face value)
categories.hint: One entry per objective you claimed: 6-8 VP each.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the most leftover money wins.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Rules read from the Pandasaurus rulebook (pp.15-16 scoring); the Xtreme Edition is the same game with upgraded components, scoring unchanged. Deluxe/2.0 and Variants (Predictable Systems, Chaos Threat Theory) not modelled. Solo mode uses an AI deck and different objective scoring, not modelled.

sources.title: Dinosaur Island Rulebook (Pandasaurus, linked from product page)
sources.section: p.15 Score Victory Points; p.16 Completing Objectives and Game End
